request.resolution_notes: Recurring pool-exhaustion incident closed after the feedback-learning comparison; retain this occurrence as future operational memory.

timeline.event: Connection pool exhaustion errors observed in checkout flow
Attempted rollback of the Friday deploy
Rollback aborted due to pending traffic; applied temporary connection‑pool limit increase
Incident declared resolved after pool usage stabilized

postmortem.root_cause: The Friday deploy introduced a configuration change that set the database connection pool max size too low, causing rapid exhaustion under normal checkout traffic.
postmortem.fix: Restored the correct pool size in the deployment configuration, added a circuit‑breaker to reject new requests when pool usage exceeds 80%, and redeployed the corrected version.
action_items: Add automated alerts for connection‑pool usage thresholds
Review and test all configuration changes in staging before production deploys
Include connection‑pool health checks in the CI pipeline
Update runbook to include rapid rollback steps for pool‑exhaustion scenarios
Conduct a post‑deployment validation checklist for payments‑api
